title: An étale lift of a finite projective complement
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $J$ an ideal, and $P$ a finite projective $A/J$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. There exist an étale $A$-algebra $A_1$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a surjective $A$-algebra map $\eta:A_1\to A/J$, and a finite projective $A_1$-module $K$ such that $P\oplus((A/J)\otimes_{A_1}K)$ is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], using the $A_1$-action through $\eta$.

source.place: Tag 07M7, first paragraph (projective complement and symmetric-algebra stabilization); Tag 07M5 for lifting the complement

proof.text: Use Module.Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective to split f:(A/J)^n→P with section g. Put Kbar=ker f. The map x↦x-g(f(x)) is a retraction onto Kbar, proving it finite projective. The inverse maps (p,k)↦g(p)+k and x↦(f(x),x-g(f(x))) identify P×Kbar with (A/J)^n, so it is free.

Lift Kbar with Tag 07M5 to K over A1, with quotient isomorphism alpha:A/J≃A1/JA1. Define eta=alpha inverse composed with the quotient map. Compatibility of alpha proves eta A-linear, and the two maps are surjective.

Identify K/JA1 K with (A1/JA1) tensor_A1 K using quotTensorEquivQuotSMul. Compose its inverse with the lift equivalence. Extend scalars by alpha inverse to A/J. The two cancelBaseChange equivalences and tensor lid identify (A/J) tensor_A1 K with Kbar. Take the product with the identity on P and transport freeness.

proof_origin.description: Source route of Stacks 07M7; explicit Lean construction and scalar transport.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite projective module admits a finite projective complement making its direct sum free
For a finite projective module P over A/J there is an etale A algebra A1 and a finite projective module K with P direct sum (A/J tensor over A1 K) free

from.place: Essential-surjectivity approximation step: Tag 07M7, first paragraph, an étale lift of a finite projective complement

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_lift_projective_complement
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (P : Type u) [AddCommGroup P] [Module (A ⧸ J) P]
    [Module.Finite (A ⧸ J) P] [Module.Projective (A ⧸ J) P] :
    ∃ A₁ : CommAlgCat.{u} A,
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A A₁))) ∧
      ∃ η : A₁ →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J, Function.Surjective η ∧
        ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : AddCommGroup K) (_ : Module A₁ K),
          Module.Finite A₁ K ∧ Module.Projective A₁ K ∧
          letI : Algebra A₁ (A ⧸ J) := η.toRingHom.toAlgebra
          Module.Free (A ⧸ J) (P × ((A ⧸ J) ⊗[A₁] K))
